request.id: finite number unique within one channel lifetime
request.payload: plain cloneable fields owned and validated by the consumer

success.value: unknown until consumer validator accepts it

channelPolicy.latestWins: a latestKey cancels and rejects its older request before the replacement is sent
channelPolicy.abort: abort-before-send posts nothing; in-flight abort posts a versioned cancel and rejects AbortError
channelPolicy.dispose: idempotent; removes listeners, rejects pending work and terminates at most once
